goals.lastAssistantText:
## Goal
- Implement Project-Wide Observability (all 15 tasks): OTel tracing, metrics, structured logging, health, alerting, async eval pipeline, guardrail instrumentation.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Follow implementation plan task-by-task; each task must pass lint + typecheck before moving on
- No scope creep beyond the PRD; new code must match existing conventions (async, structlog, dataclass patterns)
- OTel GenAI semconv as the standard; eval-as-span-attribute pattern

## Progress
### Done
- **Content Safety Guardrails (all 15 tasks)** — completed in prior session: SafetyNode fail-closed + retry + Amharic prompt, `should_revise` wired, hallucination bypass fixed, LLM claim verifier, output guardrails (toxicity/topic/PII), tool/action guard, drift monitor, 41 tests, lint + mypy clean
- **Goal evaluator fix** — `opencode.jsonc` updated: evaluator model changed to `opencode/qwen-3-coder-480b` (free OTel Zen model) to avoid DeepSeek "tool_choice" error
- **Project-Wide Observability Task 1** — OTel deps (`opentelemetry-api`, `opentelemetry-sdk`, `opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-grpc`, `traceloop-sdk`) added to `requirements.txt`
- **Task 2** — 11 observability settings added to `src/config.py` (otel, health, alerting, eval)
- **Task 3** — `src/observability/` package created: `__init__.py`, `tracing.py` (OTel GenAI semconv helpers + guardrail span functions), `instrumentation.py` (init_otel + init_openllmetry with try/except)
- **Task 4** — `src/llm/router.py` instrumented: OTel span wraps `self._manager.route()` with GenAI semconv attributes
- **Task 5** — `src/observability/metrics.py` created: Counter, Gauge, Histogram, MetricsRegistry, `timer` context manager, module-level convenience functions
- **Task 6** — `src/observability/structured_logging.py` created: `log_event()` with consistent schema (event, domain, module, outcome, duration_ms, trace_id, span_id, user_id, details, level)
- **Task 7** — `src/observability/health.py` created: ModuleHealth dataclass, ModuleHealthRegistry, singleton `health_registry`, `to_dict()` with overall_status and uptime
- **Task 8** — `src/observability/alerting.py` created: AlertThreshold with cooldown, AlertManager, singleton `alert_manager`
- **Partial Task 9** — `init_otel()` and `init_openllmetry()` wired into `main.py` lifespan

### In Progress
- **Task 9 remainder** — Wire `/health/modules` endpoint into `main.py`, register guardrail modules in health registry during startup
- **Task 10** — Create eval pipeline: sampler, judge, dimensions, writer
- **Task 11** — Create eval runner + CLI entry point
- **Task 12** — Create eval datasets
- **Task 13** — Wire eval pipeline into trace finalization
- **Task 14** — Wire guardrails with observability spans
- **Task 15** — Write tests, lint + typecheck

### Blocked
- (none)

## Key Decisions
- Use OTel GenAI semantic conventions as the 2026 standard for all LLM tracing
- Eval scores written as `gen_ai.evaluation.*` span attributes (eval-as-span-attribute pattern), not separate spans
- Async eval pipeline with LLM-as-judge on 10-20% sampled traffic, not inline
- `traceloop-sdk` not installable (network timeout); code handles `ImportError` silently — manual OTel spans still work
- Session model keeps `opencode/deepseek-v4-flash-free`; only evaluator uses `opencode/qwen-3-coder-480b`

## Next Steps
1. Add `/health/modules` endpoint to `src/main.py`, register modules in health registry (Task 9)
2. Create eval pipeline files: `eval/sampler.py`, `eval/judge.py`, `eval/dimensions.py`, `eval/writer.py` (Task 10)
3. Create eval runner + CLI entry point (Task 11)
4. Create eval datasets (Task 12)
5. Wire eval into trace finalization (Task 13)
6. Wire guardrails with observability spans + metrics (Task 14)
7. Write tests for all observability modules; run lint + typecheck (Task 15)
8. Run `ruff check` and `mypy` on all changed files

## Critical Context
- `main.py` lifespan already has `init_otel()` and `init_openllmetry()` wired after startup checks, before rate limiter
- `traceloop-sdk` (OpenLLMetry) not installed — `lib/instrumentation.py` has try/except ImportError fallback
- Guardrail modules need health registry registration and span wrapping in Task 14
- Pre-existing `unit_planner.py:111` syntax error blocks mypy on whole project; run mypy with `--ignore-missing-imports` on individual files
- Ruff line length 100; all new code must pass before moving on

## Relevant Files
- `01-Planning/PRD's/Project-Wide Observability/Implementation Plan.md`: Reference for all 15 tasks
- `src/config.py`: Added 11 observability settings (otel_*, observability_*, eval_*)
- `src/main.py`: Needs `/health/modules` route + module registration in lifespan
- `src/observability/tracing.py`: OTel GenAI semconv constants + guardrail helpers
- `src/observability/instrumentation.py`: `init_otel()` + `init_openllmetry()` with ImportError fallback
- `src/observability/metrics.py`: Counter, Gauge, Histogram, MetricsRegistry, `timer`
- `src/observability/structured_logging.py`: `log_event()` with consistent schema
- `src/observability/health.py`: ModuleHealthRegistry with `to_dict()`, singleton `health_registry`
- `src/observability/alerting.py`: AlertThreshold, AlertManager, singleton `alert_manager`
- `src/llm/router.py`: OTel span wraps LLM route call with GenAI semconv attributes
- `opencode.jsonc`: Session model `opencode/deepseek-v4-flash-free`, evaluator `opencode/qwen-3-coder-480b`

goals.lastAssistantText:
## Goal
Fix bugs found by the OpenCode review agent on GitHub PR #59 iteratively (push → review → fix → push → review) until no fix comments remain.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Fix bugs in the order of severity: high → medium → low
- Each fix must be a minimal diff addressing exactly the issue described
- Commit and push after each round of fixes; let the review agent re-check
- Repeat the cycle until the review agent returns no fix comments

## Progress
### Done
- **Bug 1 (HIGH)**: Fixed route shadowing in `src/api/assignment.py` — moved `GET /{assignment_id}` after `GET /` and `GET /my/`, moved `GET /submissions/my` before `GET /{assignment_id}/submissions`
- **Bug 2 (HIGH)**: Fixed `not` operator on SQLAlchemy column in `src/telegram/bot.py:1173` — changed `not RecoveryNotification.is_read` to `RecoveryNotification.is_read == False`
- **Bug 3 (HIGH)**: Fixed `list_for_student` mutual exclusion in `src/core/assignment/service.py` — moved `status == published` into an `else` block so it only applies when `status_filter` is absent
- **Bug 4 (MEDIUM)**: Fixed deprecated `datetime.utcnow()` → `datetime.now(timezone.utc)` in `tests/test_digital_twin_consumer.py`; added `timezone` import
- **Bug 5 (MEDIUM)**: Fixed type annotation `Mapped[dict]` → `Mapped[list]` for `score_history` in `src/database/models.py:93`
- **Bug 6 (LOW)**: Added missing blank line between `execute` and `reflect` methods in `src/agents/intervention_agent.py:33` and `src/agents/misconception_agent.py:33`

### In Progress
- Preparing to commit all fixes, push, and await next review round

### Blocked
- (none)

## Key Decisions
- Fix all 6 bugs in a single commit cycle, then push for re-review — faster iteration than one commit per bug
- These bugs were identified by the OpenCode review GitHub Action on PR #59 (run 28808983387)

## Next Steps
- `git add -A` → `git commit -m "fix: address review agent bugs (route shadowing, SQL boolean, type annotations, deprecated API)"` → `git push`
- Wait for the review GitHub Action to re-run and post new comments
- If new fix comments appear, repeat the cycle; if no fix comments, mark `[goal:complete]`

## Critical Context
- PR #59: `https://github.com/tcyber925-del/EthioBio-AI-Assistant/pull/59`
- Branch: `ethibio-knowledge-platform`
- 6 bugs found by OpenCode review agent across `src/api/assignment.py`, `src/telegram/bot.py`, `src/core/assignment/service.py`, `src/database/models.py`, `tests/test_digital_twin_consumer.py`, `src/agents/intervention_agent.py`, `src/agents/misconception_agent.py`
- All 59 backend tests still pass

## Relevant Files
- `.worktrees/backend/src/api/assignment.py`: route ordering fix (Bugs 1)
- `.worktrees/backend/src/telegram/bot.py`: SQL boolean fix (Bug 2)
- `.worktrees/backend/src/core/assignment/service.py`: filter logic fix (Bug 3)
- `.worktrees/backend/tests/test_digital_twin_consumer.py`: deprecated API fix (Bug 4)
- `.worktrees/backend/src/database/models.py`: type annotation fix (Bug 5)
- `.worktrees/backend/src/agents/intervention_agent.py`: style fix (Bug 6)
- `.worktrees/backend/src/agents/misconception_agent.py`: style fix (Bug 6)
